From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip portal invite not completing 2FA

Thanks — I dug into the logs. The invite token was properly issued but our SSO/2FA gateway registered a series of failed callbacks coming from the vendor domain; looks like a CORS header mismatch when the browser posts the OTP verification. Steps I'm taking:

- Reissuing a fresh invite token that bypasses a legacy redirect (should land on the new verification endpoint).
- Temporarily extending invite expiry to 7 days in case they need multiple attempts.
- Notifying infra to add ZipVendor's onboarding subdomain to the allowed origins list.

Alyssa: I just pushed a new invite — please use the link below in an incognito window and try to complete 2FA. If it still fails, send the network tab HAR (redact secrets) or a short video.

Invite (one-click): https://zipvendor.onboarding/accept?token=REDACTED

I'll monitor logs as you test.

—Marcus

Hi all — quick update: I accepted the new invite this morning and the account creation finished successfully. 2FA completed after a single code entry in incognito. Confirmed on Chrome Mac and iPhone. Thanks Marcus for the quick turnaround and Laura/Priyom for the escalate.

Two small asks for future onboarding runs:
- Can the invite email explicitly say 'open in incognito/private window' as a troubleshooting tip? That would save a back-and-forth.
- If possible, could the invite link include a note on expiry in the email body rather than only the landing page? A lot of our procurement folks miss expiry messaging.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to our intake on Friday.

Best,
Alyssa Nguyen
